investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Lumen Journeys (travel booking); Platform: Google Cloud us-east4 (zones us-east4-a/us-east4-b/us-east4-c); network range 10.125.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster lumen-prod-useast (GKE); Database: mysql server ancillaries-db-01 reachable from the application network only through firewall rule allow-ancillaries-to-db; infrastructure is managed with Terraform applied from CI; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
